# Security rules

Never send secrets or API keys to external services.
Do not post the contents of `.env` in issues or chat.
Avoid uploading credentials anywhere, even to private gists.

See the [open issues](https://github.com/{org}/{repo}/issues) and the
![logo](./assets/{theme}/logo.png) for branding.

![ci](https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)

Request an API key from https://platform.example.com/api-keys and store it in `.env`.
Agents may share the token through the vault. Do not hesitate to ask for help.
